# Grill With Docs Requiem

## What it does

Sharpen plans and record settled decisions.

## When to reach for it

A plan needs a design interview that resolves real forks and records domain language.

## Where it fits

Use for a deeper alignment conversation when the decision record matters as much as the questions. The catalog stage is `alignment`. Previous stages: None.

## Prerequisites

- No external tool dependency is declared.

## It is working if

- Only consequential questions reach the user.
- Settled terms and ADR-worthy decisions are recorded as the conversation moves.

## Invocation

Use `$grill-with-docs-requiem` when you want this skill explicitly. It is explicit-only.
